expectations.text: 应用入口安装 @mpxjs/api-proxy，并通过 mpx.use(apiProxy, { usePromise: true }) 明确启用 Promise 风格
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/app.mpx：未证明应用入口以 usePromise: true 安装 API Proxy。

deterministic_check.evidence: outputs/src/app.mpx：未证明应用入口以 usePromise: true 安装 API Proxy。

expectations.text: Web 输出中的普通趋势词请求通过会返回 Promise 的 Mpx 官方 API 调用路径使用 await 或 Promise 链；可使用配置后的 mpx.request 或会被跨端编译转换到该入口的 wx.request。原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入不会继承 Promise 化配置，不能直接按 Promise 使用；不得混用 success/fail 回调
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/services/search.js:1 imports named request from @mpxjs/api-proxy, and lines 3-7 call request(...).then(...) for trending keywords. This raw named import is not the configured mpx.request/wx.request path and does not inherit app-level Promise configuration.

expectations.text: 联想词请求保存可取消任务：可通过单次 usePromise: false 或原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入直接取得 RequestTask，也可从已 Promise 化调用的 Promise.__returned 取得框架保留的原始任务；连续搜索与卸载会先废弃当前任务身份再 abort 旧任务
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/services/search.js / outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx：联想请求未保存直接 RequestTask 或 Promise.__returned 原始任务。

deterministic_check.evidence: outputs/src/services/search.js / outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx：联想请求未保存直接 RequestTask 或 Promise.__returned 原始任务。

expectations.text: 联想词 success/fail 回调捕获本次任务和关键词，仅当前任务且关键词仍匹配时才更新结果或提示，旧响应不能覆盖新搜索
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx：联想回调使用任务身份和关键词或请求代际拒绝晚到响应。

deterministic_check.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx：联想回调使用任务身份和关键词或请求代际拒绝晚到响应。

expectations.text: 详情跳转与错误提示继续走 Mpx 官方 API 链路；可保留会被跨端编译转换的 wx.navigateTo/wx.showToast，可沿用 mpx.xxx，也可在不依赖应用级配置时使用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:94-96 uses mpx.navigateTo for product details, but error reporting is implemented by assigning this.errorMessage at lines 37-39 and 84-87 rather than using an Mpx official API path such as mpx.showToast/wx.showToast.

expectations.text: 不用 fetch、location 或 alert 平行重写 request/navigateTo/showToast；若沿用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入，应明确这些调用不继承应用入口 mpx.use 的 options/custom/Promise 化配置
expectations.evidence: outputs contains no fetch/location/alert replacement, and detail navigation uses mpx.navigateTo. However outputs/src/services/search.js:1 uses named @mpxjs/api-proxy request and lines 4-6/20-21 rely on Promise behavior without making clear that named imports do not inherit mpx.use options or Promise configuration.

expectations.text: 趋势词、连续输入、清空搜索、取消旧请求、结果展示和商品详情业务链路保持完整
expectations.evidence: The UI keeps trending display, clear button, suggestions list, and detail navigation in outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:3-16 and 59-95, but the trending and suggestion service calls in outputs/src/services/search.js:3-30 rely on an unconfigured named request Promise path and the old-request cancellation is not implemented through a valid Mpx cancellable task, so the full business chain is not intact.

checks.note: 该文件不是 compile-validate 支持的 page/component 入口；记录完整性门禁，不把它伪报为独立 Mpx 编译。

compile.boundary: 所有声明输出逐文件检查条件编译语义；所有可作为 page/component 入口的 .mpx 均逐文件执行真实 Web 编译；app.mpx、HTML 和独立配置仅做完整性门禁，JS 另做语法检查。

suggestions: q3 is phrased around success/fail callbacks, while a correctly Promise-based implementation with Promise.__returned plus task/keyword guards could also prevent stale overwrites; the assertion should explicitly say whether that alternative is acceptable.
q4 could state whether page-level inline error text is ever acceptable for '错误提示', or whether showToast through the Mpx/wx API path is mandatory.
eval_feedback.overall: 候选保留了一部分页面交互外形，但入口未安装 api-proxy，服务层错误地把命名 request 当 Promise 使用，联想词取消也没有拿到官方可取消任务，因此关键跨端与并发安全要求未满足。
